description: Edit a flashcard's front, back, hint or tags. Only fields you pass change; the card keeps its review schedule. Requires a personal access token with the "memo" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

back.description: Markdown is rendered on both the web app and the study flashcard: **bold**, _italic_, ~~strike~~, `code`, bullet/numbered lists, > quotes, and [links](url). A single newline renders as a line break (no need for a blank line between lines of the same side).

front.description: Markdown is rendered on both the web app and the study flashcard: **bold**, _italic_, ~~strike~~, `code`, bullet/numbered lists, > quotes, and [links](url). A single newline renders as a line break (no need for a blank line between lines of the same side).

hint.description: Empty string removes the hint. Markdown is rendered on both the web app and the study flashcard: **bold**, _italic_, ~~strike~~, `code`, bullet/numbered lists, > quotes, and [links](url). A single newline renders as a line break (no need for a blank line between lines of the same side).

name: update_memo_card
